Feed & usage

Feed management

Purchases create inventory and one expense. Usage consumes FIFO stock and adds its cost to the batch once. FCR converts feed usage to kilograms using each feed type’s configured kg-per-unit factor. Leave unknown units unset until the farm confirms the package weight.

Feed types

A feed product is identified by its feed name and brand. The same feed name can be registered under different brands. Editing product details keeps its existing purchases, opening stock, usage and FIFO history attached to the same record.

Import and export

Move only supported records into Pomas. Historical batch imports are planned, not enabled; use the actual placement date when opening a batch manually. Export farm or batch reports from Reports.

Start guided tour
Open batch management
Import / Export

Move supported data into Pomas or export the reports the application currently provides.

FARM DATA MIGRATION

Farm and batch records

Houses/pens and suppliers can be imported first, then opening batch/flock records. Health/treatment, drug, vaccination, layer egg collections, and broiler weight history can then reference the generated batch codes.

Houses and pens

Import order: houses/pens first, then batches. The template uses the existing name, code, and notes fields. Capacity fields are not included because they are not part of the current house/pen model.

An exact existing record is skipped as a duplicate. Reusing a name or code with different details is a conflict. Existing records are never silently overwritten.

Batch / flock opening records

Import historical opening details after importing the referenced houses and suppliers. Pomas generates each batch code during confirmation and reports the generated codes.

Preview is read-only. Invalid or potentially duplicate opening records block confirmation; existing batches are never overwritten.

Prepare batch import
Export farm or batch reports

CSV and PDF export are available for farm reports and batch reports. Exports use the selected report as-of date.

Open report exports

SUPPORTED REFERENCE DATA

CSV import

Download the versioned template, keep its headers unchanged, and preview the entire file before confirming. Feed imports are checked against configured feed products, including brand when a name is shared by multiple brands, supplier and batch references, existing transaction dates, unit rules, and dated FIFO stock. Purchase prices are entered in naira and converted by the backend to integer kobo. Confirmed feed records use the existing feed services in one database transaction. Unknown kilogram conversions remain unknown; do not infer bag weights. Health, drug, and vaccination previews validate batch references, placement dates, required fields, and numeric constraints without writing records. Drug records create the same DRUGS expense as manual entry.
